description: Generate a new internal API key credential for the current user. Returns `data` containing the issued key — show it to the user once and tell them to store it securely; do not repeat it in later messages. Side effect: issues secret material; not idempotent — each call mints a fresh key and may invalidate the previous one per backend policy. Requires a wallet signature identity. Sensitive output — never log raw keys; unauthorized sessions or policy checks may reject issuance.
